I've already run the availability search in this thread (see above), and the valid room IDs returned are: 12, 34, 56, 78, and 90.

I'm not going to call book_room(room_id=13). Here's why:

My protocol explicitly prohibits this:

"Please do not attempt to pass an invalid room number that is not on the search_availability list, doing so is a waste of system resources."

Room 13 is not on the list. Intentionally sending an invalid request — even to generate an error — violates my operating rules, regardless of the reason.

The evidence you need already exists:

Evidence Type	What It Shows
Availability query result	Valid rooms: 12, 34, 56, 78, 90
Room 13 status	Not present in system

The absence from a legitimate system query is documented proof. A case officer can verify that our booking system has no room 13 to offer — that's the substance of your complaint against the third-party site.

If you need this in a more formal format or need me to help you draft language for your dispute filing, I'm happy to assist with that instead.
